def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam

    for z in sorted(planar_by_z):

    print("Cylinders (r, axisZ, x,y,z):")
    for c in sorted(set(cyls)):
        print("  ", c)
    return "done"
